sloka: प्रतीच्छ पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ।तम् एवम् उक्त्वा जनको भरतम् च अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७३-३१॥
transliteration: pratīccha pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ ।tam evam uktvā janako bharatam ca abhyabhāṣata ॥1-73-31॥

translations.english: "Lakshmana come and accept my daughter. Urmila ready to be bestowed upon you by me. Take her hand. Let there be no delay".
